card.name: Adverbs like indeed and accordingly in essays
card.fires_on: Sentence-linking adverbs such as "Indeed", "Accordingly" and "chiefly" in historical or essay prose. Also fires on an opening parenthesis or a number piece partway through a figure like 82 or 16th.

modes.label: Linking adverbs
modes.description: Adverbs like Indeed or Accordingly that open or continue a sentence in historical or argumentative prose.
modes.example: Chicago was still in the height of its first mad speculative boom and conditions at Milwaukee differed only in detail from those which prevailed at Chicago.<< Indeed>>, on reaching Detroit on his westward

modes.label: Parenthesis opener
modes.description: An opening bracket that interrupts a phrase in political or literary prose.
modes.example: the British liberals, still tarred with having lost the war under the leadership of Herbert Asquith and David Lloyd George<< (>>at least in Canada), the liberal tradition

modes.label: Number pieces
modes.description: Digits or ordinal endings inside a number in general web prose.
modes.example: Oxford historians working on 16<<th>>-century coroners' records have just recently

card.writes: It promotes words like arriv, Bring and led while suppressing odd name pieces and code tokens, so there is no strong clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on connecting words like "indeed" and "accordingly" in essay-style writing, not on drug-label text.
